items.title: Bank of America Just Told Investors to Sell UPS, and the Reason Has Nothing to Do With Package Volume
items.summary: Bank of America just cut UPS to sell, and the catalyst has nothing to do with shipping demand or Amazon competition. The real threat is a regulatory change that turns UPS's fastest, highest-volume lanes into a compliance liability that surcharges alone may not fix.
